title: Magnetic Field-Enabled Delivery of Polymer-Coated Iron Oxide Nanoparticles to Breast Cancer Cells
author: Bulatao, Nalinratana, et al.
materials: computer with CorelDRAW and CorelLASER programs
Freshly prepare 50 mL of each FeCl2·4H2O and FeCl3·6H2O solution as follows:

Note: This volume is sufficient to make four formulations. The quantities of FeCl2·4H2O and FeCl3·6H2O are based on a stoichiometric mole ratio of 1:2. The total Fe precursor (mole) is 0.0010.a.Weigh 0.2485 g of FeCl2·4H2O and 0.6760 g of FeCl3·6H2O.Note: Handle FeCl2·4H2O with care due to its oxidation sensitivity. Clean spatulas are necessary to prevent degradation of FeCl2·4H2O. FeCl2·4H2O crystals should be light green without any brown particles (FeO). Store FeCl2·4H2O and FeCl3·6H2O reagent bottles tightly sealed on a dry shelf or in a cabinet at 20–25 °C and away from natural light.b.In separate 50 mL conical tubes, dissolve each Fe salt in 30 mL ultrapure water.Note: The synthesis of IONPs needs strict experimental conditions control. Using clean, dry 50 mL conical tubes helps to prevent unwanted reactions. An initial volume of 30 mL ensures adequate vortex mixing of the powder.c.Seal each tube, vortex mix for 1 min, and sonicate the tubes at 9 W for 10 min while keeping the bath cool with ice.d.Add 20 mL of ultrapure water to each tube, then vortex mix again.Note: Alternatively, invert the tubes 20 times for adequate mixing since blending a 50 mL solution in a 50 mL conical tube may need some pressure adjustment for efficient vortex mixer use. Use these solutions within 8 h.

steps.title: Prepare sodium alginate solution
steps.instruction: Make a 0.2 mg/mL sodium alginate (Alg) solution (250 mL total) and filter it.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 mL ultrapure water to a 500 mL Erlenmeyer flask, insert a magnetic bar (40 × 8 mm), and stir at 600 rpm, 45 °C for 15 min.
Gradually add 50 mg sodium alginate powder while stirring, cover the flask with ParafilmⓇ M and continue stirring for 60 min.
Add ultrapure water to bring the volume to 250 mL.
Fit a filter adapter onto a 500 mL filtering flask, place a Buchner funnel on the adapter, and center a membrane filter.
Moisten the membrane and the interior of the funnel with a small amount of the alginate solution.
Pour the solution against the funnel walls until the funnel is two‑thirds full, avoiding direct contact with the membrane.
Apply vacuum, keeping the membrane wet until all solution is filtered.
Transfer the filtrate to a 500 mL bottle, cap tightly, and store at 4 °C (use within 3 days).

steps.title: Prepare chitosan solution
steps.instruction: Make a 0.23 mg/mL chitosan (CS) solution (50 mL total) and filter it.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 100 mL of 1 % (v/v) acetic acid by diluting 1 mL glacial acetic acid with 95 mL ultrapure water.
Transfer 40 mL of this acetic acid to a 250 mL Erlenmeyer flask.
Add 11.5 mg chitosan powder gradually, cover with ParafilmⓇ M and shake at 150 rpm for 24 h to dissolve completely.
Adjust pH to 5.0 with 2 M NaOH (prepare 0.8 g NaOH in 10 mL water to make 2 M solution); then add ultrapure water to a final volume of 50 mL.
Set up filtration as in step 1 (filter adapter, Buchner funnel, membrane).
Moisten the membrane and funnel interior with a small amount of the CS solution.
Pour the solution against the funnel walls until two‑thirds full, avoiding direct contact with the membrane.
Apply vacuum, keeping the membrane wet until filtration is complete.
Transfer the filtrate to a 500 mL bottle, cap tightly, and store at 4 °C (use within 3 days).

steps.title: Prepare iron‑salt solutions
steps.instruction: Freshly prepare 50 mL each of FeCl₂·4H₂O and FeCl₃·6H₂O solutions (total Fe moles = 0.0010, 1:2 mol ratio).

substeps.instruction: Weigh 0.2485 g FeCl₂·4H₂O and 0.6760 g FeCl₃·6H₂O (handle FeCl₂ under clean conditions, keep away from light).
In separate 50 mL conical tubes, dissolve each salt in 30 mL ultrapure water.
Seal each tube, vortex‑mix for 1 min, then sonicate at 9 W for 10 min while keeping the bath on ice.
Add 20 mL ultrapure water to each tube, vortex‑mix again (or invert 20 times).
Use the solutions within 8 h.

steps.title: Synthesize CS/Alg‑IONPs
steps.instruction: Combine Alg solution, iron salts, ammonia, and CS to obtain polymer‑coated iron‑oxide nanoparticles.

substeps.instruction: Pour 55 mL Alg solution into a 150 mL Duran® beaker, add a magnetic bar (25 × 6 mm).
Bubble nitrogen through the Alg solution for 10 min, then cover with ParafilmⓇ M and secure with rubber bands.
Attach a nitrogen‑filled balloon to the beaker to maintain saturation.
Load 13 mL FeCl₂·4H₂O solution into a 20 mL syringe, connect needle, prime pump, and fix the syringe pump vertically above the beaker (hole in Parafilm for needle).
Set syringe pump flow rate to 40 mL/h (syringe diameter 20.12 mm, volume 10 mL).
Stir the beaker at 1000 rpm, room temperature, for a total of 45 min:
– After 15 min, the pump delivers 10 mL FeCl₂·4H₂O; then stop pump and continue stirring for another 30 min.
After the 45 min total, add 10 mL FeCl₃·6H₂O solution under the same nitrogen‑saturated conditions.
Add 6 mL of 30 % (w/v) ammonia solution to raise pH to 10; continue stirring at 1000 rpm for 30 min (black Alg‑IONP precipitate forms instantly).
Remove Parafilm and magnetic bar.
Place the beaker on a permanent magnet (50 × 50 × 20 mm³) to attract Alg‑IONPs; wear goggles, nitrile gloves, and a face mask.
Add 80 mL ultrapure water, swirl gently, and re‑place the beaker on the magnet. Let settle 2–3 min and discard supernatant.
Repeat the wash (add 80 mL water, settle, discard) until the dispersion reaches pH ≈ 7.0 (four washes); verify absence of chloride ions with 1 % (w/v) AgNO₃.
Resuspend the washed Alg‑IONPs in ultrapure water to a final volume of 50 mL; insert a magnetic bar and cover with Parafilm secured by rubber bands.
Stir for 10 min, sonicate 20 min, then stir another 10 min (dispersion pH 6.0–6.5).
Re‑saturate the beaker with nitrogen using the balloon.
Load 13 mL CS solution into a fresh 20 mL syringe and deliver 10 mL CS to the Alg‑IONP dispersion (pH before addition 6.0–6.5; after addition 5.4–5.7).
Use the permanent magnet to pull the resulting CS/Alg‑IONPs to the beaker wall for 2 min; decant ~30 mL supernatant to remove excess CS.
Transfer the remaining mixture to a pre‑weighed 50 mL conical tube; attract the NPs to the tube wall with the magnet for 2 min and decant the liquid.
Freeze the tube at –20 °C for 4 h, then lyophilize at –80 °C for 24 h to obtain dry powder.
Subtract the empty‑tube mass from the tube mass to determine NP yield (≈ 50–55 mg dry CS/Alg‑IONPs).

steps.title: Prepare 1 L DMEM basal medium
steps.instruction: Make 1000 mL of DMEM basal medium at room temperature (non‑sterile steps allowed).

substeps.instruction: Measure 1000 mL ultrapure water; pour 800 mL into a 1000 mL beaker.
Dissolve one sachet of DMEM powder in the 800 mL while stirring magnetically.
Add 3.7 g NaHCO₃ and stir until fully dissolved.
Measure pH and adjust to 7.2 with 1 M HCl added dropwise.
Add ultrapure water to bring the final volume to 1000 mL.

steps.title: Filter basal DMEM (basal growth medium)
steps.instruction: Sterilize 1 L basal DMEM by vacuum filtration inside a biosafety cabinet (BSC).

substeps.instruction: Sanitize the BSC with UV light for 30 min and wipe with 70 % ethanol; sterilize all materials with 70 % ethanol.
Attach a bottle‑top vacuum filter to a pre‑sterilized 500 mL bottle and connect the vacuum pump.
Pour 500 mL of the basal DMEM along the sides of the filter, turn on vacuum, and filter.
Cap the bottle; repeat with the remaining 500 mL.
Note: The first 500 mL will be used later as serum‑free DMEM stock for nanoparticle treatments.

steps.title: Prepare complete growth medium
steps.instruction: Formulate 500 mL of complete DMEM (serum‑supplemented) inside the BSC.

substeps.instruction: Sanitize the BSC and materials as in the previous step.
Measure 445 mL sterile serum‑free DMEM into a sterile 500 mL bottle.
Add 50 mL heat‑inactivated fetal bovine serum (pre‑inactivated at 56–58 °C for 30 min) using a sterile pipette.
Add 5 mL PenStrep (1 % v/v) gently swirl to avoid bubbles.
Aliquot 40 mL of the complete medium into sterile 50 mL conical tubes, seal with ParafilmⓇ M, and store at 4 °C until use.

steps.title: Prepare 1 L PBS solution
steps.instruction: Make phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) and sterilize it.

substeps.instruction: Measure 1000 mL ultrapure water and pour into a 1000 mL beaker.
Add PBS powder and stir until completely dissolved.
Transfer the solution to a 1000 mL bottle, loosely cap.
Autoclave at 121 °C for 20 min; let cool to room temperature and close the cap.
Inside the BSC, dispense 40 mL into sterile 50 mL conical tubes, seal with ParafilmⓇ M, and store at 4 °C.
Seal the remaining PBS in the 1000 mL bottle with ParafilmⓇ M and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare MTT stock solution
steps.instruction: Create a 5 mg/mL MTT stock solution (10 mL) and aliquot it.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 50 mg MTT powder into a 15 mL conical tube.
Add 1 × PBS to reach a final volume of 10 mL (5 mg/mL) and vortex 1 min.
Sonicate the tube for 5 min in an ice bath.
Dispense 1 mL aliquots into 2 mL Eppendorf tubes, wrap each in foil, and freeze at –20 °C until use.

steps.title: Prepare CS/Alg‑IONP working suspensions
steps.instruction: Make 6 mL of 2 mg/mL CS/Alg‑IONP stock in serum‑free DMEM and dilute to desired concentrations for a 96‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 12 mg freeze‑dried CS/Alg‑IONP powder into a small plastic bag.
UV‑sterilize the powder in the BSC for 15 min.
Transfer the sterilized powder to a 15 mL conical tube and add serum‑free DMEM to a final volume of 15 mL.
Vortex 30 s, then sonicate 5 min to obtain a homogeneous suspension (stock concentration 2 mg/mL).
Calculate the volume of stock needed for each working concentration (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 100 % v/v). Prepare 2 mL of each working suspension (each well will receive 0.2 mL).
Adjust each working suspension to the correct final volume with serum‑free DMEM; mix thoroughly by vortexing.
